configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Development build. Uses sdkconfig.defaults from the project root. The build/ directory is shared with `idf.py build` (run via tools/build.sh) so CMake re-runs inside the same cache as the CLI toolchain. Set IDF_PATH in your CLion CMake profile environment (see tools/clion-setup.md). It is intentionally NOT set here because the path is per-machine.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Release / size-optimized build. Same toolchain as default but with -O2 and assertions off. Pick this when you're measuring firmware size against the 3 MB factory partition.

configurePresets.name: size-analysis
configurePresets.description: Size-optimized for accurate size measurement. Use with `idf.py size` or `idf.py size-components` after build to see what's eating the flash budget.
